coverage_note: This is a starting evidence register, not an exhaustive requirement inventory. Passing tests cover only the assertions named below. Endpoint presence does not establish semantic conformance.

assertions: Content hashes cover unredacted typed-event content
Reference hashes redact then omit signatures and unsigned
Local event_id is excluded from hashes and signatures
Ed25519 bytes match an independent OpenSSL vector
limitations: Unknown PDU fields are not retained; no separate PDU wire model

assertions: Known event types retain the v11 content subset
Create content is retained
Only third_party_invite.signed survives member pruning
Unsigned data is removed
limitations: Top-level unknown fields and other room-version rules still need a wire-model audit

assertions: v2 send_join and invite resolve at standard paths
Missing authentication is rejected
Authentication covers the full URI through nesting
Former incorrectly versioned paths are absent
limitations: This does not prove complete join/invite authorization, PDU shape, or independent peer interoperability

assertions: Device-list positions do not skip queued messages
Messages persist until a following sync acknowledges their cursor
Repeated sync and process restart preserve unacknowledged messages
Acknowledging an earlier batch retains later messages
Wildcard targets expand to actual devices
Acknowledgement by one device preserves other device queues
Pending and newly queued messages complete long-polls promptly
limitations: Whole HTTP transaction and rejected-response replay remain open; peer testing covers to-device messaging, not all federation surfaces

assertions: Normal UIA registration and password login work through the binary
Profile and message Unicode survives HTTP/storage
Two users create/join/send/sync
Retry before restart returns the same event
Restart preserves tokens, signing keys and message history
Logout invalidates the device token
limitations: These journeys do not establish complete client-server conformance or durable transaction deduplication

assertions: Port zero reports actual bound address after migrations
Malformed/occupied addresses and unwritable readiness files fail startup
Fixture owns and cleans up isolated process/database/media

scope: Canonical JSON and PDU validation/authorization/state resolution

evidence: conduit/src/api.rs contains API-version constants and placeholders; no client application exists in the workspace
scope: Unattended unit, integration and browser e2e verification

evidence: Pinned live Synapse 1.162.0 bidirectional to-device journey passes with certificate, hostname and signature verification enabled
limitations: CI and full independent protocol coverage remain missing

assertions: Subscribe before observing pending streams
Non-room wake hints do not trigger push/AS room-event workers
To-device, device-list, account-data, receipt, typing and presence updates end a long-poll
Typing stop and expiry emit empty replacement lists
Restart resets ephemeral cursors without resetting durable cursors
Account-data and receipt overwrites use real observed stream positions
Room-only account data and ephemeral updates appear without new timeline events
Unchanged visible data waits until the original deadline
limitations: Commit-order and concurrent snapshot consistency need an independent audit
Durable changes from other processes currently use periodic polling

assertions: Private receipts are returned only to their owner
Multiple public receipt users coexist for the same event
Presence sync is restricted to self and shared joined-room users
Presence status reads require authentication and enforce visibility
Unrelated presence updates do not expose status or finish a poll early
limitations: Threaded and fully-read receipts and complete room/event authorization remain open

assertions: Sync reports own-device OTK counts and unused fallback algorithms
Pending upload and claim changes bypass the long-poll timeout
Fallback usage advances the inventory summary independently of device-list changes
Unchanged inventory does not cause busy polling
Inventory fingerprint uses canonical JSON
limitations: Key identity validation, encrypted-room device-list visibility and independent encrypted clients remain open

assertions: Successful room-send results persist atomically with events
To-device deduplication, local queues and remote outboxes commit atomically
Concurrent retries have one committed effect
Scope includes user, device and complete logical endpoint
Retries survive restart and do not reexpand wildcard recipients
Failed writes roll back deduplication and all effects
limitations: Rejected HTTP response replay and complete transaction-front-door semantics remain unproven
Event authorization/state publication is still outside the storage commit

assertions: Remote deliveries use m.direct_to_device EDUs in standard /send transactions
Sender is the authenticated Matrix user, not a bare server name
Stable message IDs use at most 32 Unicode codepoints
Inbound sender domain matches the verified origin
Message-ID deduplication survives different enclosing transactions and restart
Queued remote delivery recovers after an unavailable peer and restart
Pinned live Synapse produces and consumes both directions over verified TLS
limitations: Whole enclosing federation transaction replay remains open
Legacy queued to-device rows without sender metadata cannot be converted into valid EDUs
Full federation PDU/room-version/auth/peer conformance is not proven

assertions: Operator PEM roots preserve normal outbound TLS verification
Missing and invalid configured roots fail startup
Live-peer fixture provisions processes, databases and certificates without human interaction
Missing prerequisites and assertion failures exit nonzero
